# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary analysis documents generated as part of the ZavaLoanPortal modernization assessment. Use the links below to navigate to each fact document.

## Supplementary Documents

| Document | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| [Architecture Diagram](architecture-diagram.md) | Application architecture diagram showing technology layers, data flow, and component relationships |
| [Dependency Map](dependency-map.md) | Visual map of all external and framework dependencies grouped by functional category |
| [API & Service Communication Contracts](api-service-contracts.md) | Service catalog, communication patterns, security posture, and service interaction sequence diagram |
| [Data Architecture](data-architecture.md) | Database configuration, entity model (ER diagram), data ownership, caching strategy, and data sensitivity classification |
| [Configuration Inventory](configuration-inventory.md) | Comprehensive inventory of all configuration sources, properties, secrets, build/runtime profiles, and framework versions |
| [Business Workflows](business-workflows.md) | Core business processes, domain entities, service-to-domain mapping, and business rules & decision logic |
